title: Same bag. Part 1
note: Silent. Frame 1 fully composed, no fade, ONE strip (hook, 0-3.0, y=345). Arrivals hall, generic board ARRIVALS / BELT 4, belt carousel behind. Two large faces: his phone lit mid-swipe (generic profile-card glow, no UI; thumb flicks 0.2-1.4), her phone lit too in one hand, and in her other hand the kraft luggage tag, the biggest and brightest object, reading (that one's mine.). He holds a grey suitcase by the handle; the bag has a chartreuse tag loop (HERS). At 1.7 his thumb stops and he freezes; at 3.6 an identical grey bag with NO loop rides past behind him (planted: his own). Part 1 is the season opener: no take 1, no rewind. Own payoff before the cliff: she writes where his bag is, he swaps bags, they laugh (12.4), both phones go into the bags (13.6). Cliff: she takes the blank tag off HIS bag and writes (rough trip?); his bag pocket buzzes with a match and he ignores it; belt stops, board flips to BELT 4 / EMPTY. Vote board up by 23.5 s. Whenever the tag carries a line it is a WHOLE-FRAME insert (tag ~920 px wide, centred around y=760, Caveat 700 ink on kraft, hand drawn in). Text only between y=270 and y=1250. No NoSwipe mention (none in part 1). No airline, airport or place names; board text is generic. Her lines are dry and kind; the joke is only his wrong grab. Revision 2: second strip 1.2-3.2; hers/mine labels; she ties a short ribbon on his handle (12.4-14.0, laugh); phones enter their own front pockets 14.0-15.3 (his first); ping = phone-shaped glow in his pocket, calm small smile; wide = him holding pen over tag, bags on the floor; vote question carries the cause.

hooks.a: the stranger at baggage claim swipes too.
hooks.b: a stranger caught me swiping at baggage claim. she wrote this.

hookProp: a | b (only the hook strip text in 0-3.0 changes; the body is identical)

choices.question: she asked if it was a rough trip. what do I write?
choices.why: Both are about him. A is the busy-man brag; B is the honest, self-deprecating answer about his own date (no woman is the joke). B is the planned winner. Part 2 plays A first and fails on him (he sounds pompous, then his bag rides off on the belt and he trails after it), belt reverses as the rewind, then B carries on.

strips.text: the stranger at baggage claim swipes too.
a stranger caught me swiping at baggage claim. she wrote this.
I grabbed her bag. it looks like mine.
I said sorry on her tag.
she told me where mine was.
she marked mine. so I'd stop taking hers.
my phone buzzed. a match. I didn't look.
she asked if it was a rough trip. I flew in for a date. it flopped.
